scripts.test:syntax: node -e "const{execFileSync}=require('child_process'),{readdirSync,statSync}=require('fs'),p=require('path');let n=0;(function walk(d){for(const e of readdirSync(d)){if(e==='node_modules')continue;const f=p.join(d,e);if(statSync(f).isDirectory())walk(f);else if(e.endsWith('.js')){execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f]);n++;}}})('.');console.log('syntax OK: '+n+' files');"
